title: Bloch's Law for Finite-Range Heisenberg Ferromagnets in Three Dimensions

abstractEnglish: We prove Bloch's T3/2 law for the spontaneous magnetization of three-dimensional quantum Heisenberg ferromagnets at every fixed positive quantum spin. The result holds for every nonnegative symmetric finite-range interaction whose support generates ℤ3, including spatially anisotropic couplings. The leading magnetization deficit has the exact coefficient determined by the determinant of the quadratic one-magnon dispersion. The thermodynamic limit is taken before the right field derivative at zero, and the low-temperature limit is taken last.

details.overview: 稿件研究三维量子Heisenberg铁磁体在固定正量子自旋下的自发磁化。摘要表示，作者对每个非负对称有限程相互作用（其支撑生成ℤ³，包括空间各向异性耦合）证明了Bloch T^{3/2}定律；磁化亏损的首项系数由单磁子二次色散的行列式精确确定。热力学极限先于零场右导数，低温极限最后取。作者声称结果覆盖各向异性有限程情形。该工作属于量子统计力学中铁磁相变研究；摘要未说明证明方法细节。
keyPoints: 研究对象为三维量子Heisenberg铁磁体在固定正自旋下的自发磁化。
作者声称对支撑生成ℤ³的有限程对称相互作用证明Bloch T^{3/2}定律。
首项系数由单磁子二次色散的行列式精确给出。
